audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate places call Illaoi dash-less: 'She has no dash to close the gap', 'Illaoi's dash-less kit', 'her immobility means she will never catch you'.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson (W) is a leap. Riot's text: 'Illaoi leaps to her target, dealing physical damage and causing nearby Tentacles to also swing at the target.' 400 range, 4 second cooldown, and it is also an auto-attack reset. It is short, but a Teemo who has been told she cannot close will hold his ground at 450 units and die to a 4-second-cooldown leap plus a tentacle volley.
audit.corrected: Her one gap-close is Harsh Lesson: a 400-range leap on a 4s cooldown that resets her auto and makes every nearby tentacle swing. Stay further out than that, not just out of auto range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Test of Spirit is described as 'rip your spirit out and force you to fight your own tentacle', with no explanation of what to actually do once it lands.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit and counter-intuitive: 'Spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take to the original target. If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel.' So both instincts a ranged champion has — kill the thing, or run from it — are the two ways to become a Vessel. The correct play is to stay beside the spirit and let it expire while not damaging it. This is the highest-value missing line in the matchup.
audit.corrected: If Test of Spirit lands, do not kill the spirit and do not run from it: damage to it echoes onto you, and killing it or leaving it turns you into a Vessel. Stay beside it and let it time out.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'the Test of Spirit cooldown (about 18 seconds at low CDR)'.
audit.why: It is 16/15/14/13/12. Eighteen seconds is longer than the real number at every rank, so a player pacing his trades off it walks into a live E.
audit.corrected: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 down to 12s at rank 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'she cannot proc her W tentacle slap without landing autos' and 'Cruel Tentacle'.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is a targeted leap, not an on-hit rider — it lands and swings her tentacles whether or not she is blinded. And 'Cruel Tentacle' is not an ability in her kit at any slot; her damage sources are Tentacle Smash, Harsh Lesson, Test of Spirit and Leap of Faith plus passive tentacles.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart removes her auto damage but not Harsh Lesson; there is no ability called Cruel Tentacle.

audit.whatIsWrong: Teemo's Q is written 'Blinding Shot' in spikes[0] and elsewhere.
audit.why: It is Blinding Dart. Same character count, so the swap is length-neutral.
Not an item; the repo's canonical string is 'Liandry's Torment'.
Level 6 called out as the one honest Skill row because Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle per champion hit — that matches the kit and matches the 59.2% overall.

edits.before: Blinding Shot erases Illaoi's auto-trade entirely — she cannot proc her W tentacle slap without landing autos, so you own every short trade from wave one.
edits.after: Blinding Dart kills Illaoi's auto damage, but Harsh Lesson is a 400-range leap on a 4s cooldown that lands regardless and swings every tentacle near you.

edits.before: Liandry's Angueur turns your Toxic Shot DoT into a percentage-health burn — Illaoi's high base HP becomes a liability, and she cannot outheal stacking poison damage with one Corrupting Potion.
edits.after: Liandry's Torment turns your Toxic Shot DoT into a percentage-health burn — Illaoi's high base HP becomes a liability, and she cannot outheal stacking poison damage with one Corrupting Potion.

edits.after: Sidestep Test of Spirit every trade — 16s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — then run your Blinding Dart and poison pattern on that window

edits.before: Blinding Shot comes online and erases her entire trade pattern: she cannot proc W without landing autos, and a blinded Illaoi stands there dealing zero damage while your poison ticks.
edits.after: Blinding Dart erases her auto damage, but it does nothing to Harsh Lesson — that is a targeted 400-range leap, so it still lands and still swings every tentacle near you.

edits.before: Full kit online — E poison, Q blind, and W disengage give you a safe in-and-out trade loop Illaoi's dash-less kit cannot punish if you dodge Test of Spirit.
edits.after: Full kit online — poison, blind and Move Quick give a safe in-and-out loop, but her Harsh Lesson leap covers 400 units every 4 seconds, so respect that gap.

edits.before: At level 1 Illaoi has no reliable way to trade without her autos landing — walk up, auto her on every minion last-hit, and let Toxic Shot stacks accumulate. The moment she raises her hand to Test of Spirit, strafe sideways; the projectile is slow and telegraphed. If it misses, immediately fire Blinding Shot and auto twice before walking back — she cannot retaliate without autos and her tentacles only slap if she is nearby. At level 2 your blind window is your full trade license: step into auto range, Q her, stack two poison autos, and W out before Test of Spirit comes back. She has no dash to close the gap, so every time you do this cleanly you win the trade by a significant margin.
edits.after: At level 1 Illaoi has no reliable way to trade without her autos landing — walk up, auto her on every minion last-hit, and let Toxic Shot stacks accumulate. The moment she raises her hand to Test of Spirit, strafe sideways; the projectile is slow and telegraphed. If it lands anyway, do not kill your spirit and do not sprint away from it — damage to the spirit echoes onto you, and both killing it and leaving it turn you into a Vessel. If it misses, fire Blinding Dart and auto twice before walking back. At level 2 your blind is your trade licence: step in, Q her, stack two poison autos, and W out before Test of Spirit returns. Her only gap-close is Harsh Lesson, a 400-range leap, so hold that distance and you win the trade cleanly.

edits.before: By levels 4-5 Blinding Shot is nearly max-rank and the Test of Spirit cooldown (about 18 seconds at low CDR) means you can run your full trade pattern twice per wave. Hold the wave slightly toward your tower, force Illaoi to walk through the tribush to contest, and shroom that bush before she arrives — she will either eat the mushroom slow and take free poison autos, or give up the minions. At level 6 her Leap of Faith summons tentacles at her current position: never all-in when she is standing inside a tentacle cluster because R turns her from helpless to lethal in one cast. Instead, use Noxious Trap to shroom her tentacle positions and force her to hold R defensively — that gives you another full poke cycle for free.
edits.after: By levels 4-5 Blinding Dart is near max rank and Test of Spirit is 16 seconds at rank 1, 12 at rank 5 — that window, not your own Q, is what lets you run the full trade pattern twice a wave. Hold the wave slightly toward your tower, force Illaoi to walk through the tribush to contest, and shroom that bush before she arrives — she eats the slow and takes free poison autos, or gives up the minions. At level 6 her Leap of Faith summons a tentacle for every champion it hits: never all-in while she is standing in a tentacle cluster, because R turns her from helpless to lethal in one cast. Shroom her tentacle positions instead and force her to hold R defensively — that buys you another full poke cycle.

edits.before: With Liandry's Angueur stacked on your Toxic Shot poison, Illaoi's high HP pool works against her — the percentage burn means the more tanky she builds, the faster the DoT kills her. Shroom every jungle entrance toward your split-push lane and walk away every time her Test of Spirit comes off cooldown; her immobility means she will never catch you through a mushroom wall. If she holds Leap of Faith to avoid being kited, you simply keep farming and denying — she cannot take the tower without walking into lethal shroom coverage, and she cannot engage without gifting you a free poison trade on her own terms.
edits.after: With Liandry's Torment stacked on your Toxic Shot poison, Illaoi's high HP pool works against her — the percentage burn means the more tanky she builds, the faster the DoT kills her. Shroom every jungle entrance toward your split-push lane and back off every time Test of Spirit is up; her only gap-close is a 400-unit Harsh Lesson leap that needs you already in range, so a mushroom line she has to walk is a wall she cannot cross. If she holds Leap of Faith to avoid being kited, you simply keep farming and denying — she cannot take the tower without walking into lethal shroom coverage, and she cannot engage without gifting you a free poison trade on your own terms.

edits.before: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — Her vessel pull. Sidestep it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5. Sidestep it; if hit, do not kill your spirit. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: Whoever writes the boilerplate should know that Illaoi is repeatedly described as immobile across this file. She is slow, but Harsh Lesson is a real 400-range leap on a 4-second cooldown, and 'she has no dash' is the sort of line a player will trust and then die to. Also: the missing-interactions file flags needs-antiheal for her passive (Prophet of an Elder God heals her when tentacles hit a champion) — the full layer already carries 'anti-heal stays core' in breakdown.late, so no edit was needed there.
